graph.title: LEGO 7603-1 Dump Truck
notes: Changes from the last version: bumper bricks p12/p13 now sit under the front edge of the grey slope p20 (and bed p19), so they clutch real studs. Their headlight round plates sit on their free end studs. p20 rests on p4, p12 and p13.
Wheels were moved to sit flush against the holder pins.

Each tyre (p26-p29) is stretched over its wheel (p22-p25), so the pair must occupy the same space. Their centres are aligned exactly in column, row and layer. Any remaining overlap warning for those four pairs is not a placement error: a tyre cannot be mounted without wrapping its wheel.
The wheels, tyres, holders and ladder p16 attach by pins or sideways, not by stud-on-stud. I recorded those as other_joins. The ladder grille touches the front of the base and the bumper bricks.
The cab body (p15, p1, p4) is 2 studs wide, so the tyres sit outside it. Front is at column 0, with the bed at the rear.
Positions are approximate reads of a small, low-detail booklet.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 7603-1 Dump Truck
notes: The booklet is small and low-detail, so positions are approximate reads of the pictures.
Front of the truck (grille) is at column 0 and to the left; the bed is at the rear (right).

The model is built upside-down-ish at step 8, when the wheel holders are fitted under the black base plate. Final layers are for the finished model, with the base plate at layer 4 and the wheels near layer 0.
Some pieces overlap or have uncertain positions: the cab front bricks p12/p13, the ladder p16, and the stacked 1x2 plates p9/p10/p11. These are best guesses.
